title: ErrorResponse
description: Standardized public error payload for all service endpoints. Omits raw SQL text, stack traces, database credentials, or provider details to prevent disclosure.

message.description: Safe, user-facing summary message describing the error
message.example: The submitted prompt requested non-read-only data operations which are prohibited.

details.description: Optional list of non-sensitive validation or contextual error items

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the error occurred

request_id.description: Unique correlation identifier for server log tracing
